description.title: החרגות נוספות
description.summary: This table lists additional general exclusions to a professional liability insurance policy for investment advisors. It details situations where the policy will not provide coverage, specifically related to losses from capital markets fluctuations and market abuse.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מפרטת החרגות נוספות לפוליסת ביטוח אחריות מקצועית ליועצי השקעות. החרגות אלו מתייחסות למקרים בהם הפוליסה לא תכסה הפסדים הנובעים מתנודות בשוקי ההון, שימוש במידע פנימי, והתנהגות המהווה ניצול לרעה של שוק ההון. הפוליסה אינה מכסה אחריות משפטית כתוצאה מאובדן ערך והשקעות שמקורן בתנודות בשוק ההון או בבורסה. החרגות כוללות שימוש במידע לא-ציבורי, עידוד צדדים שלישיים לפעולות אסורות, והתנהגות המהווה ניצול לרעה של שוק ההון לפי חוק שירותי פיננסיים ושווקים משנת 2000 או חוקים דומים.  החרגות מתייחסות גם לשימוש במידע פנימי, ניצול לרעה של שוק ההון, והתנהגות אסורה.
notable_values: Market Abuse Exclusion: use of non-public information
Financial Services and Markets Act 2000: prohibited actions

sketch:
Additional General Exclusions:
Exclusion  of  any  legal liability  as  a  result  of  loss  of  value  and\or investment originating from fluctuations in the Capital Markets and or at the Stock Exchange.
' The Policy  does  not  cover  any  loss  arising  out  of,  based  upon  or
Market Abuse Exclusion attributable to
Any use or procurement by an insured, whether acting alone or in collusion with others, of or aiding or abetting by an insured in the procurement  and/or  use  of , or  participation  after  the  fact  by  any insured in the procurement and/or use of , non-public information in relation  to  investments  traded  on  any  recognised market  in  a manner prohibited by law or any rules or regulations promulgated under any law; or
Requiring or encouraging a third party to engage in actions which, if engaged in by the first person, would amount to prohibited actions; or
Behavior which constitutes market abuse pursuant to the provisions of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 or similar laws '.

טבלה: החרגות נוספות
This table lists additional general exclusions to a professional liability insurance policy for investment advisors. It details situations where the policy will not provide coverage, specifically related to losses from capital markets fluctuations and market abuse.
ממדים: exclusion type, description of exclusion

Additional General Exclusions:
Exclusion  of  any  legal liability  as  a  result  of  loss  of  value  and\or investment originating from fluctuations in the Capital Markets and or at the Stock Exchange.
' The Policy  does  not  cover  any  loss  arising  out  of,  based  upon  or
Market Abuse Exclusion attributable to
Any use or procurement by an insured, whether acting alone or in collusion with others, of or aiding or abetting by an insured in the procurement  and/or  use  of , or  participation  after  the  fact  by  any insured in the procurement and/or use of , non-public information in relation  to  investments  traded  on  any  recognised market  in  a manner prohibited by law or any rules or regulations promulgated under any law; or
Requiring or encouraging a third party to engage in actions which, if engaged in by the first person, would amount to prohibited actions; or
Behavior which constitutes market abuse pursuant to the provisions of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 or similar laws '.
